info: A compass is a navigation tool that uses a freely rotating magnetic needle to show direction. Earth behaves like a giant magnet, and its magnetic field causes the marked end of the needle to align toward Magnetic North. The compass dial displays the four cardinal directions—North, East, South, and West—and the four intermediate directions. When using a compass with a map, rotate the map until its north direction aligns with the compass needle.

options: Point the compass toward the Sun
